acceptance_criteria: GAP-PKG-045 adopts the existing VERIFIED SHELL-CON-002::GLOBAL application-identity foundation and does not create a competing application catalog, AppCode universe or semantic source.

applications.json remains the versioned source for the ten canonical application identities; generated AppCode and application metadata remain reproducible from that source and hub/default remain non-canonical application identities.
The package-specific evidence explicitly covers TREQ-SHELL-003, TREQ-SHELL-028 and TREQ-SHELL-034 with deterministic fixtures, expected results and fail-closed assertions.

The evidence must detect any current launcher, login metadata, AppSwitcher, navigation runtime or absolute destination that diverges from the canonical application contract; a proven consumer/product delta blocks verification and requires re-maturation with exact repository and path before modification.
No Supabase mutation is part of GAP-PKG-045 maturation or evidence-only adoption, and no database migration is created or changed by this package scope.
The seven reserved tests/packages/GAP-PKG-045 evidence artifacts are the only new physical evidence targets authorized by this dossier before a proven re-maturation need.

The existing SHELL-CON-002::GLOBAL foundation files remain byte-stable during package evidence materialization; later SHELL-CON-* additions that share generated files are not re-owned or reverted by GAP-PKG-045.
Production remains unauthorized. The declared execution environment is TP-SHARED-001 over ENV-WEB-CI-STAGING under OWN-OPS governance.
rollback_steps: If package-specific evidence materialization fails, revert only the GAP-PKG-045 evidence files created by the authorized implementation instance; do not alter the already VERIFIED SHELL-CON-002::GLOBAL foundation.

If tests prove that a product, consumer or shared-contract delta is required, stop the implementation and re-mature GAP-PKG-045 with the exact repository, path, symbol or surface and operation before making that delta.
No database rollback is required for the dossier as currently scoped because Supabase mutation is explicitly outside the package and production is unauthorized.
After any evidence rollback, rerun generate-authorization-types --check, validate-authorization-catalog and the canonical regression facade to confirm the pre-package foundation remains unchanged.
